functions.purpose: Real logic (not a serializer): loads a monster's AISetting overrides from its BlackBoardFile property node and pushes Health, RageDec, TailFire values into the entity's blackboard/behavior-tree variables. Reads Properties.<...>.AISetting[.PropertyCustom] node.
formulas: Guard: if param_1[0x4d]!=0 OR param_1[5]==0 OR blackboard-holder null -> skip. param_1[0x3f] = result of vtbl+0x24 call (node id).
Reads sub-node path 'Properties.' then optional 'PropertyCustom' + '.AISetting.' / '.AISetting'.
Health: node->GetFloat('Health', out); if found AND out>0.0 -> format float (fmt &DAT_11da0cf4) and set BB var 'Health' via FUN_113168d0/FUN_1046d130.
RageDec (via DAT_11dbc56c string) and 'RageDec': if found AND >0.0 -> set BB var.
TailFire: GetString via vtbl+0x3c; if found and differs from empty -> set BB var 'TailFire' (string).
Uses FUN_104a1b30 to stringify float with a printf-style format DAT.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server-side AI): Health/RageDec/TailFire are per-monster AI tuning overrides read from the monster's property/blackboard file. RageDec = rate at which monster rage decays; Health scalar; TailFire = tail-fire state var. Server driving monster AI must apply these overrides.
functions.notes: CryEngine blackboard/BT plumbing (FUN_113168d0 = find BB key, FUN_1046d130 = set BB value, FUN_1046dc90 = key-valid check). DAT_11dbc56c is a string constant (likely 'RageDec' or a Rage key); exact key unverified. Confidence medium due to heavy pointer aliasing in decompile.

functions.purpose: Iterates a behavior-tree node stats map (in-order tree walk) and emits per-node runtime profiling records (NodePathRT, TimeStamp, NodeName, NodeId, TotalMiliSec, AccountTime, SuccessTime, FailureTime, Average, Percent) into an output object.
formulas: Node record offsets (from iVar6 node): NodePathRT(string, lowercased) built from +0x20/+0x24; TimeStamp @+0x3c; NodeName resolved via FUN_11317f30; NodeId @+0x4c; TotalMiliSec @+0x44; AccountTime @+0x50; SuccessTime @+0x54; FailureTime @+0x58; Average(float) @+0x5c; Percent(float) @+0x60
Path chars uppercase->lowercase normalization: if '@'<c<'[' then c+=0x20.
Tree walk over red-black tree nodes rooted at param_1+0x28 (successor iteration).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (debug/telemetry profiler for behavior-tree nodes). Not gameplay-authoritative.
functions.notes: Stock CryEngine/AI profiler dump; documents BT node stat layout only.

functions.purpose: Looks up a CBuffInfo static-data record (buff definition) by buff id using the CInfoManager sparse 2D-bucket index. Returns pointer to the buff config record or 0.
formulas: mgr = CBuffInfo::GetInfoManagerSingleton() -> *mgr, fallback CInfoManager::FindByName('CBuffInfo',0).
Lookup (sparse-id): base@mgr+0x30, stride@mgr+0x28, count@mgr+0x24, buckets@mgr+0x20.
Valid if id!=-1 AND (id!=0 OR base==0) AND stride!=0 AND (idx=id-base) in [0,count).
record = buckets[idx/stride][idx%stride]; return 0 if bucket null.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative data-table accessor: fetches the buff DEFINITION (duration, magnitude, stacking rules, category) by id. Server must load the equivalent CBuffInfo table. The record struct itself is defined elsewhere (cross-ref schema/docs/skill.md CBuffInfo).
functions.notes: Standard MHO CInfoManager sparse-id lookup idiom; matches the formula documented in schema/docs/pet.md.
